cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.0.2)
project(paper_px4_bridge)
add_compile_options(-std=c++14)
find_package(catkin REQUIRED COMPONENTS roscpp nav_msgs sensor_msgs geometry_msgs pcl_ros local_planner message_generation)
add_service_files(FILES EvaluationStep.srv)
generate_messages(DEPENDENCIES nav_msgs sensor_msgs geometry_msgs)
catkin_package(CATKIN_DEPENDS message_runtime local_planner)
include_directories(${catkin_INCLUDE_DIRS})
add_executable(paper_px4_bridge_node src/bridge.cpp)
add_dependencies(paper_px4_bridge_node ${${PROJECT_NAME}_EXPORTED_TARGETS} ${catkin_EXPORTED_TARGETS})
target_link_libraries(paper_px4_bridge_node ${catkin_LIBRARIES})
